name: ReIFE
description: ReIFE is a meta-evaluation suite for instruction-following evaluation that assesses the accuracy and robustness of LLM-based evaluators across multiple base LLMs, evaluation protocols, and human-annotated datasets.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the ReIFE paper that is mainly cited within the LLM evaluation community and has not yet seen broad adoption.
notes: Includes evaluation of 25 base LLMs and 15 evaluation protocols on 4 human-annotated datasets; provides codebase and evaluation results for over 500 LLM-evaluators.
